description: Verify that Unaligned 3-message SOME/IP bundle over TCP — DUT echoes each Request
approach:
[Objective]
TCP byte-stream bundling: messages may not be byte-aligned across segments — DUT's parser must walk the stream by SOME/IP length headers.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT responded to every message — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_response_missing: DUT did not respond to every message in TCP bundle
